heading: INT. ST. MARGARET HOSPITAL - NURSES STATION - NIGHT

units.text: INT. ST. MARGARET HOSPITAL - NURSES STATION - NIGHT
The ward is quiet.
The clock on the wall shows 3:10.
A cleaner pushes a mop slowly past the station and does not look at anyone.
In the corner a vending machine hums.

PRIYA sits with a clipboard, DR. ALBERT eats a sandwich with great care, TOMASZ is looking at his phone and GLORIA, the night manager, walks in a circle around the desk with a mug in her hand and a smile that does not move.
Everybody, tonight is very calm. Maybe the calmest night this year.
units.name: PRIYA
paren: she closes the clipboard

units.text: Please do not say this word. Calm. It is a bad word in hospital.
units.name: DR. ALBERT
paren: he chews, then points to the sandwich

units.text: I am sorry. I take it back.
units.name: PRIYA
paren: laughing, she touches the wooden desk

units.text: Again no message from my wife. Maybe she is sleeping.
units.name: TOMASZ
paren: to himself, he reads the screen

units.text: ON PHONE: Tomek where r u?
Come home early pls.
Dog is sick.
You see? The dog. Always the dog.
units.name: TOMASZ
paren: he turns the phone to Priya

units.text: You have a dog? I thought you hate animals.
units.name: PRIYA
paren: she reads and nods

units.text: I hate everything at three in the morning.
units.name: TOMASZ
paren: quietly, to the room

units.text: Friends, I am so happy with this team. Really. Look at this peace.
units.name: GLORIA
paren: she lifts the mug to all of them

units.text: Why is she so happy? She is never happy.
units.name: DR. ALBERT
paren: to Priya, low, he lowers the sandwich

units.text: Maybe she had good sleep.
units.name: PRIYA
paren: whispering, she shrugs

units.text: I heard this. I am fine. Please, continue your work.
units.name: GLORIA
paren: she hears and smiles wider

units.text: Two TEENAGERS in school jackets come through the doors, one holding a bloody paper towel to the other's chin.
Nobody stands up.

Priya waves them to the waiting chairs without looking, Tomasz types a reply with one thumb, and Dr. Albert hides the sandwich under a folder while Gloria walks to the window and looks down at the parking lot as if she is waiting for someone.
The desk phone RINGS.
Priya answers.
Ward four, Priya speaking.
units.name: PRIYA
paren: into the phone

units.text: Priya, good evening. This is the Director, from the head office. I am downstairs. I am coming up to see your ward.
units.name: DIRECTOR
paren: through the phone, calm and slow

units.text: It is the Director. He is downstairs.
units.name: PRIYA
paren: she covers the receiver, to everyone

units.text: Ah no. No, no.
units.name: DR. ALBERT
paren: he stands, the folder falls, the sandwich falls

units.text: Now I understand why she smile.
units.name: TOMASZ
paren: he puts the phone away and fixes his hair

units.text: He has been in the building since midnight. I did not tell you because I wanted to see your real work.
units.name: GLORIA
paren: turning from the window, very quietly, to all

units.text: Welcome, Director. We are ready.
units.name: PRIYA
paren: into the phone, with a very small voice

units.text: I know. I saw everything on the camera.
units.name: DIRECTOR
paren: the elevator DINGS behind the phone voice

units.text: The elevator doors OPEN at the end of the corridor.
The cleaner with the mop stops, takes off his cap, and looks at the four of them.
Is the cleaner the Director?
units.name: TOMASZ
paren: a whisper

units.text: Nobody answers.
The cleaner smiles.
